_what: Point-in-time index membership for the backtest, walked backwards from the current constituent list through the dated changes table. Intervals are [from, to) with `to` exclusive; null = open / before history. See engine/universe_history.py and docs/DATA.md.
name: sp500-history

source.note: Built 2026-09-10 from the fja05680/sp500 mirror of the Wikipedia tables (raw.githubusercontent.com/fja05680/sp500/master/sp500_changes_since_2019.csv and sp500.csv, current through 2026-08-18) because en.wikipedia.org is denied at the egress proxy of the build session; the mirror agrees with the live page row-for-row on 2024-09-23..2026-06-30 and additionally carries ticker renames (FISV/FI, BK/BNY, PARA/PSKY, MMC/MRSH, SATS/ECHO) the page's 'selected changes' table omits. Membership before 2019-01-18 is NOT in this file (--since clamps it). Re-run 'python3 engine/universe_history.py --index sp500 --out experiments/universe_sp500.json --since 2019-01-18' from a host that can reach Wikipedia to replace it with a direct fetch.

bias: UNIVERSE sp500-history 2019-01-18..2026-09-10: 505 members on 2019-01-18, 503 on 2026-09-10, 671 distinct names over the window. 168 of those are NOT in the current constituent list (AAL, AAP, ABC, ABMD, ADS, AGN, AIV, ALK, ALXN, AMG, AMTM, ANSS, ...) — a backtest on today's list would have dropped them, and removals skew toward the losers (acquired at a discount, fallen below the size floor, or delisted). 0 change rows carried no parseable ticker or date and were skipped. RESIDUAL BIAS: the source table is 'selected' changes, not all of them; price bars for removed names are only present if the bars source still serves delisted symbols — a name with membership but no bars is silently absent, exactly the old bias in miniature; and names renamed without a row keep their old ticker. State this in every write-up; do not delete it because the report reads better without it.
